lede: Know where to ride, stay, eat and refill in Ajdovščina.
intro: Ajdovščina sits in the upper Vipava valley, on the site of a Roman fort. One signed route runs through it: Vipava (Učna pot ob reki Vipavi), a local route along the river. The municipality climbs from vineyard villages such as Brje, Budanje and Črniče up to Col, Otlica and Hrušica on the plateau.

routes.title: The cycle route through Ajdovščina
routes.body: One signed route passes through Ajdovščina, and it follows the river. Vipava (Učna pot ob reki Vipavi) is a local route of 48 km, 14 km of it inside Ajdovščina.

stays.title: Where to stay with your bike
stays.body: Ajdovščina has 12 places to stay, from a hotel in the centre to a farm at 1,000 metres. In Brje, Turistična kmetija Birsa has rooms and apartments 470 metres from the Vipava route. Hotel Gold Club is in the middle of town, 2.4 km from the same route. Avtokamp Ajdovščina, 2.8 km from the route, is a ten-minute walk from the centre in a pine wood and rents bikes and e-bikes. Up on the plateau, Penzion Sinji vrh looks out over the Vipava valley and has e-bikes, 5.1 km from the route.

food.title: Where to stop and eat
food.body: You have 10 places to eat in Ajdovščina, spread between the valley and the plateau. Picerija Anja in Budanje, 980 metres from the Vipava route, has made pizza for more than 30 years and serves daily lunches. At Kamp David in Malovše, 2.0 km from the same route, a small bakery makes bread each morning. Guerila in Planina, 1.6 km from the route, makes biodynamic wine and offers tastings. Up in Hrušica, Gostilna Stara Pošta cooks home-style dishes and game next to the Roman site Ad Pirum.

practical.title: Water, repair and charging
practical.body: Only 3 of the 47 public water points are within 150 metres of a signed route, so carry a full bottle. There are three public repair stations. For a bike shop, you can choose between Kamplc sport, Kobra and Velocenter Ajdovščina. For an e-bike, Ajdovščina has 4 public chargers.

sights.title: What to see on the way
sights.body: Ajdovščina has 66 sights, and two of them are Roman. Castra, the Roman fortress the town grew from, is 2.7 km from the Vipava route. Otliško okno, a natural stone window on the plateau, is 5.6 km from the same route. Trilek Castle is 4.5 km from it. Ad Pirum, a Roman fortress built in the 320s on the Hrušica plateau, is 11.7 km from the Vipava route.
